name: Sequential Pro 2
description: Sequential Pro 2 (DSI), every program and global parameter in its Operation Manual's NRPN tables.

sources.title: Pro 2 Operation Manual (version 1.2)
sources.notes: NRPN tables read by tools/profiles/sequential/read-nrpn-tables.mjs from Pro-2-Operation-Manual-1.2.pdf, pages 104-106-107-144 (sha256 8d59ccba7874b6f03c32eb3f94d168cf724ddb2032806798f0c3f70835f7df3a), https://sequential.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Pro-2-Operation-Manual-1.2.pdf. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/sequential/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/sequential/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the manual's NRPN tables, on its number, with its printed range and name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Values go out as the manual prints the format: NRPN MSB/LSB on CC 99/98, value MSB/LSB on CC 6/38. The instrument must have its Global MIDI parameter receive set to NRPN (or All).
1 parameter(s) the manual marks as transmitted but ignored when received are read-only.
Left out, the program name, one character per NRPN; CEditor cannot edit text over NRPN yet: NRPN 480, 481, 482, 483, 484, 485, 486, 487, 488, 489, 490, 491, 492, 493, 494, 495, 496, 497, 498, 499.

Left out, printed with the range "0, 128": NRPN 768 (Track 1, Step 1 Tie), 769 (Track 1, Step 2 Tie), 770 (Track 1, Step 3 Tie), 771 (Track 1, Step 4 Tie), 772 (Track 1, Step 5 Tie), 773 (Track 1, Step 6 Tie), 774 (Track 1, Step 7 Tie), 775 (Track 1, Step 8 Tie), 776 (Track 1, Step 9 Tie), 777 (Track 1, Step 10 Tie), 778 (Track 1, Step 11 Tie), 779 (Track 1, Step 12 Tie), 780 (Track 1, Step 13 Tie), 781 (Track 1, Step 14 Tie), 782 (Track 1, Step 15 Tie), 783 (Track 1, Step 16 Tie).
